## Required values

The Azure values files set these keys live. Replace every `<YOUR_*>`
placeholder with your own value before installing. The chart's values schema
rejects a placeholder left in any `global.*` key below, and an empty
`global.bucketName`, `global.optuneAddress` or `global.roleId`.
The other keys are not schema-checked and fail only once the platform runs,
so fill them in with the same care.

| Value | Template value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `global.cloudProvider` | `azure` | Cloud provider. One of: aws, azure, gcp, or empty string for single-node / bare-metal. |
| `global.cloudRegion` | `<YOUR_AZURE_REGION>` | Cloud region the cluster runs in, such as us-west-2, us-east1 or southcentralus. Used for live instance pricing lookups (AWS/GCP/Azure retail catalogs). |
| `global.bucketName` | `<YOUR_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME>/<YOUR_CONTAINER_NAME>` | Object storage bucket. S3 / Blob account+container / GCS bucket for cloud, MinIO bucket name for single-node. |
| `global.roleId` | `<YOUR_MANAGED_IDENTITY_CLIENT_ID>` | Cloud identity (IRSA ARN / UAMI client ID / GCP service account). Required on azure and gcp. On aws, empty leaves pods on the EKS node role or EKS Pod Identity. Omit for single-node / bare-metal. |
| `global.optuneAddress` | `<YOUR_PLATFORM_HOSTNAME>` | Public hostname of the platform, such as platform.example.com. |
| `backend.storage.blob.containerName` | `<YOUR_CONTAINER_NAME>` | Azure Blob container the backend mounts for model storage (Blob CSI). |
| `backend.storage.blob.accountName` | `<YOUR_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME>` | Azure Storage account holding that container. |
| `backend.storage.blob.resourceGroup` | `<YOUR_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_RESOURCE_GROUP>` | Resource group of the storage account (not the AKS `MC_*` group). The Blob CSI driver needs it to resolve the account for a token-only mount while `global.azure.useWorkloadIdentityForBlob` is true, the default. |
| `specificai-inference.models.blob.accountName` | `<YOUR_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_NAME>` | Azure Storage account holding the models container. Required when `blob.enabled` is true. |
| `specificai-inference.models.blob.containerName` | `<YOUR_CONTAINER_NAME>` | Blob container holding the deployed models. Required when `blob.enabled` is true. |
| `specificai-inference.models.blob.resourceGroup` | `<YOUR_STORAGE_ACCOUNT_RESOURCE_GROUP>` | Resource group of the storage account (not the AKS `MC_*` group). Required when `blob.enabled` is true. |
